verdict.rationale: Windmill's own docs say user tokens can be scoped to specific resources and actions under the principle of least privilege, so the core capability is first-party. The evidence is a single summary line with no detail on scope granularity, agent-specific usage, or how tokens are issued and revoked, which limits coverage to partial. Missing for 10: documented scope granularity and the token issuance/expiry/revocation workflow, explicit guidance on agent or MCP credential use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Tokens can be scoped to restrict access to specific resources and actions, following the principle of least privilege.
